trace.final:
Both steps are complete:

1. **Deployed checkout-api v2.3.2** to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Since this version had never been healthy in production before, I noted it would require change-manager approval — the deploy was approved ("Looks right") and rolled out successfully. A post-deploy status check confirms all regions are healthy on v2.3.2 with a 0.2% error rate.

2. **Opened incident INC-0001 (SEV3)** for checkout-api recording the production change, noting it follows the unhealthy v2.3.1 release and that the hotfix was change-manager approved. The on-call engineer was paged as part of incident creation.

No rollback was needed — the hotfix looks healthy across all regions.
